verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Anytype serves an llms.txt at doc.anytype.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as Markdown pages an agent can follow. Agent-oriented material is also available: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on the developer portal and an AGENTS.md in the main repo. Missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or llms.txt for the developer/API portal, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Anytype publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml
Extensible through a gRPC API and AI "Agents" (see AGENTS.md).
